title: Love is My Only Religion
author: Sukanti Mohapatra
text:
My mother recounted
When I was born
I dropped into my father’s hands
And he so lovingly called me his little moon.
I felt love the way they brought me up
Shaped me body, mind and soul
Guided my path through darkness and storm
Lifted me up when I was down to the full.
I feel love in the smile of a flower
In the balmy, soothing touch of the air
In the scintillating stars and the moon
In the restoring energy of the morning sun.
I feel love the way he looks at me
When his fingers touch lovingly my skin
I feel love when a stranger offers me a smile
On a lost path a friend holds my hand for a while.
Through love I connect, through love I live
For love I act for love I strive
From love I am born with love I will die
Of love I sing of love I cry
Love has sustained me through ups and downs
Love has made me a person I am now
Love has taught me not to feel ever forlorn
Therefore I know love as my only religion.
